evidence.content_summary: Ars reported on Aug. 12, 2014 that Sony’s pre-Gamescom conference mentioned an immediately downloadable PS4 playable teaser P.T. from unknown 7780s studio, later revealed as Silent Hill-related.
Gematsu reported on Aug. 12, 2014 that Sony announced P.T. from 7780s Studio during Gamescom and that the interactive teaser was available on the PlayStation Store.
Push Square reported Sept. 1, 2014 that Kojima announced at Sony’s pre-TGS conference that P.T. had been downloaded over one million times.
PlayStation Universe reported Sept. 1, 2014 that Sony announced P.T. had exceeded one million downloads since launch.
WIRED quoted Kojima explaining that the “S” in 7780s points to Silent Hill/Shizuoka wordplay and that searching 7780 leads to the approximately 7,780-square-kilometre area of Shizuoka.
A contemporaneous GameFAQs community thread proposed that 204863 can be read as 24/08/63, Kojima’s birth date. This verifies existence of a fan theory, not creator intent.
Gematsu reported that the official P.T. site stated distribution on PlayStation Store would expire Wednesday, April 29, 2015.
GameSpot later reported that P.T. had been removed from the PlayStation Store in all regions, after Konami announced the Apr. 29 removal.
GameSpot reported multiple eBay listings for PS4 consoles with P.T. installed, including two UK listings at £1,000 (about $1,500) buy-it-now and some listings up to $1,800.
Kotaku reported May 7, 2015 that eBay was taking down PS4-with-P.T. listings and relayed an eBay explanation tied to selling copyrighted software.
Ars reported Geoff Keighley’s live statement that Kojima was informed by a lawyer representing Konami that he would not be allowed to travel to The Game Awards to accept awards.
Game Informer independently reported the same live Keighley statement; both reports derive from the same broadcast and therefore share an independence group.

Game Developer reported Lance McDonald’s camera hack and quoted his finding that Lisa attaches behind the player after the flashlight and follows as the player moves. The report does not establish a precise numeric distance.

limitations: Secondary report of McDonald finding; exact implementation offsets are not documented here.
technical.method: Camera behavior modification reported from Lance McDonald P.T. hack.

evidence.content_summary: Prima Games reported the same Lance McDonald finding that Lisa attaches to the player’s back after the flashlight. This is derivative of the same technical observation and is not an independent corroboration.
GAME Watch reported that Konami public relations confirmed Kojima left on Dec. 15, 2015 upon expiration of the contract period.
A report reproduced Kojima’s public statement that his employment contract with Konami terminated as of Dec. 15, 2015.

A GameFAQs theory thread states that community discussion connected the Swedish radio line about a 75-year-old radio drama to Orson Welles’s 1938 War of the Worlds broadcast and surveillance/alien themes. This supports existence of the community theory, not its truth.
Community discussion documents the bloody talking paper bag and speculative interpretations, but does not support the specific claim that it symbolizes Kojima being oppressed or trapped by Konami.

3DJuegos reported that a 2020 allegation claimed MGSV budget/resources funded P.T. secretly, and reported Kojima Productions denied the allegation; the outlet said it had not run the original claim because it considered it low credibility.

A community thread discusses the fetus and pregnancy-related story interpretations, but does not support the specific later metaphor that the fetus represents the cancelled game project being “miscarried.”
On May 6, 2015 GameSpot reported testing that P.T. could no longer be downloaded even by users who had previously added/downloaded it.
On May 6, 2015 Game Informer updated its report to say Konami confirmed P.T. had been completely deleted from the PlayStation Store; re-download reports were documented that day.

gaps.question: Research Pack narrative places the re-download lock in December 2015, while contemporaneous May 6, 2015 reports document that re-download was already blocked. Preserve this as an explicit source discrepancy rather than silently editing the pack.
gaps.resolution_summary: Contemporaneous GameSpot testing and Game Informer/Konami confirmation place the no-re-download condition on May 6, 2015. The pack’s December 2015 wording should not be used as a factual timeline point.

gaps.question: What exact numeric offset and rotation constraints were used for Lisa relative to the player/camera after the flashlight? The inspected McDonald-derived evidence establishes the behind/follow relationship but not the Research Pack’s specific 0.5 m precision.

limitations: Web-accessible historical evidence only; paywalled/original Japanese sources may not be fully available.
A repeated secondary report of the same primary statement is not treated as independent corroboration.
Community threads can verify that a theory/rumor existed, not that the underlying interpretation is true.
